title: Tutte-polynomial equality for diagram matroids and positroids
statement: Let $w\in S_n$. Let $DM_w$ be the diagram matroid associated to the permutation diagram of $w$, and let $\mathscr{P}_w$ be the corresponding positroid. **Tutte-polynomial equality conjecture.** For any $w\in S_n$, the Tutte polynomial of $DM_w$ equals the Tutte polynomial of $\mathscr{P}_w$. The equality has been checked through $S_7$, while the source does not report a proof in general.
source_name: Brendan Pawlowski, “Catalan matroid decompositions of certain positroids”, arXiv:1502.00158 (2018).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1502.00158

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of February 2015). “This conjecture has been verified through $S_7$.”
